evidence.notes: The static resource helper returns a PageReference URL for the named resource.
The nested static resource helper appends the path inside the zip resource.

source.content: @isTest private class PageReferenceResourceEvidenceTest { @isTest static void resourceUrlsResolve() { PageReference resource = PageReference.forResource('Images'); System.assert(resource.getUrl().startsWith('/resource/')); System.assert(resource.getUrl().endsWith('/Images')); PageReference nested = PageReference.forResource('Images', 'icons/logo.png'); System.assert(nested.getUrl().startsWith('/resource/')); System.assert(nested.getUrl().endsWith('/Images/icons/logo.png')); } }
